# Experiment
Experiments are simple, unremarkable Sawians, often called cannon fodder.
While being a mix of multiple species, they are mostly canine - certain foods, like coffee or chocolate will poison them. Their claws make them adept at unarmed combat, and their eyes emit a permanent bioluminescent glow, helping see in the dark.
They are rather cowardly and withdrawn in nature, fitting more in worker roles rather than leading. Some would call them mischevious.
